name: wisp
description: Control web browsers through the Model Context Protocol using Chrome DevTools
long_description:
Wisp is a powerful browser automation tool that enables AI assistants like Claude to control web browsers through a Chrome DevTools extension. It provides a seamless bridge between MCP clients and browser automation, allowing you to navigate pages, interact with elements, capture screenshots, and extract information from websites.

Key features:
- Navigate and control browser tabs
- Click, hover, and interact with page elements
- Fill forms and input fields
- Capture screenshots of pages or specific elements
- Extract DOM content and query elements
- Monitor console logs in real-time
- Support for multiple simultaneous browser connections

tools.name: list_tabs
tools.description: List all connected browser tabs

tools.name: tab_detail
tools.description: Get detailed information about a specific tab

tools.name: navigate
tools.description: Navigate browser tab to specified URL

tools.name: back
tools.description: Navigate back in browser history

tools.name: forward
tools.description: Navigate forward in browser history

tools.name: click
tools.description: Click on a page element using CSS selector or XPath (first match, its unique selector is returned), or at a viewport coordinate by passing x and y instead

tools.name: hover
tools.description: Hover over a page element using CSS selector or XPath (first match, its unique selector is returned), or at a viewport coordinate by passing x and y instead

tools.name: focus
tools.description: Set focus on a page element using CSS selector or XPath

tools.name: blur
tools.description: Remove focus (blur) from a page element using CSS selector or XPath

tools.name: fill
tools.description: Fill an input field with a value using CSS selector or XPath

tools.name: select
tools.description: Select an option from an HTML <select> dropdown element using CSS  selector or XPath

tools.name: keypress
tools.description: Send a keypress event to the current tab or a specific element

tools.name: type
tools.description: Type a string as individual keystrokes (real keydown/keyup/input events per character) via Chrome DevTools Protocol

tools.name: insertText
tools.description: Insert a whole string at once into the focused element via Chrome DevTools Protocol (like an IME commit or paste - fires input/beforeinput but no per-key events)

tools.name: clear
tools.description: Clear a text field by selecting all of its contents and deleting them with real key events (Ctrl/Cmd+A then Backspace) via Chrome DevTools Protocol

tools.name: screenshot
tools.description: Capture a screenshot of the page or specific element using CSS selector or XPath

tools.name: dom
tools.description: Get outerHTML of the body or a specific element using CSS selector or  XPath

tools.name: elements
tools.description: Query all elements matching a CSS selector or XPath and get detailed  information about each element

tools.name: scroll
tools.description: Scroll the page or an element

tools.name: dialog
tools.description: Respond to a JavaScript dialog (alert, confirm, prompt, or onbeforeunload) that is blocking the tab

tools.name: elementsFromPoint
tools.description: Get information about all elements at a specific coordinate in the viewport

tools.name: console_logs
tools.description: Get the browser tab's console contents - what you would see in the DevTools console, including console messages, uncaught exceptions, and browser-generated entries (network errors, violations, etc.)

tools.name: watch_console
tools.description: Watch a browser tab's console in real time

tools.name: network_monitor
tools.description: Turn network monitoring on or off for a browser tab

tools.name: network_requests
tools.description: List the network requests captured since monitoring was enabled

tools.name: network_body
tools.description: Fetch the bodies for a single captured request by `requestId` (from network_requests)

tools.name: evaluate
tools.description: Execute JavaScript in the page and return the result

tools.name: compose
tools.description: Run a sequence of commands against a single tab in one call

tools.name: new_tab
tools.description: Opens a new browser tab with the Wisp MCP usage documentation page

tools.name: close
tools.description: Closes a browser tab

tools.name: reload
tools.description: Reloads the current page in the browser tab

tools.name: show
tools.description: Brings the browser tab to the front and focuses it
